# GlowScroll: LED Banner & Sign

> GlowScroll turns a phone or tablet into a bright scrolling LED sign for concerts, airport pickups, games and events. It is made by THE LIX GROUP LLC for iOS and Android and is coming soon (not yet in the app stores). There is no account, no ads and no tracking in the app; signs are stored on the user's device. It is free to use; a one-time Premium purchase (no subscription) unlocks extra looks and unlimited saved signs.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android (in development, not yet released)
- Category: Utilities (LED banner, scrolling text sign)
- Account required: No
- Data storage: On the user's device. No GlowScroll server.
- Free: scrolling LED and smooth text, colors, speed and direction, blink and rainbow effects, mirror mode, Flash Safety, quick phrases, 20 saved signs, any language and emoji
- Premium (one-time, no subscription): Square LED, Pixel and Neon looks, unlimited saved signs, future Premium features
- Support: glowscroll-support@lixlink.com
